articles.title: Rubio warned Trump of Nvidia CEO's affair with Chinese 'spy'. Did he ignore it?
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump expressed confidence in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding allegations of ties to a Chinese spy. Trump stated he believes Huang was unaware of the alleged spy's identity during an FBI investigation.

articles.title: 'Injured throat with scissors': Kolkata techie's girlfriend 'can't remember' argument
articles.summary: Sarthak Sarkar, a software engineer, was found murdered in his rental flat in Kolkata after a domestic dispute. His live-in partner, Sanchalika Basu, and her mother, Moumita Basu, have been arrested in connection with the case.

articles.title: 'I'd quake in my seat': Sonia recalls Indira's temper, early days as bride in memoir
articles.summary: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, offers an intimate account of Indira Gandhi’s temper, recalling how staff were made to stand in corners, a senior Congress leader ordered to face a wall and others ignored for days. Sonia also describes Rajiv’s reassurance during her mother-in-law’s outbursts, Indira’s domestic routines, love for sarees and photographs, and how grandchildren gradually softened her temperament..

articles.title: 'Warrants urgent attention': SC flags vehicle pollution in Delhi-NCR, seeks action plan
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has mandated that Delhi and three adjacent states intensify measures to combat vehicle emissions. Officials are tasked with reporting on the implementation of laws governing aging and non-compliant vehicles.

Over 2,000 teachers, students face political persecution in Bangladesh: Report
articles.summary: Since August 2024, over 2,000 students and teachers have reportedly faced politically motivated persecution across Bangladesh. The persecution includes academic exclusion, physical attacks, and criminal proceedings targeting individuals linked to the Bangladesh Awami League.

articles.title: Russia's last major independent newspaper Novaya Gazeta shuts down after 33 years
articles.summary: Novaya Gazeta, an independent newspaper critical of the Kremlin, has shut down its Moscow office after three decades. The closure came as a result of mounting government pressure and sustained restrictions on independent media.

articles.title: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026: JKSA seeks increase in upper age limit to 40 years for Open Merit candidates, urges LG Manoj Sinha to intervene
articles.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Students Association (JKSA) has urged Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha to intervene and raise the upper age limit for J&K Bank recruitment to 40 years for Open Merit candidates. Citing a nearly six-year recruitment gap, the association has also sought additional age relaxation for Probationary Officer and Banking Associate aspirants..

articles.title: AP Special TET Final Answer Key 2026 expected today, check download steps and result date
articles.summary: AP Special TET Final Answer Key 2026: The AP Special TET 2026 Final Answer Key is expected to be released on November 10 by the Department of School Education, Andhra Pradesh. Candidates will be able to download paper-wise and shift-wise keys for Papers 1A, 1B, 2A and 2B.

articles.title: Odisha Civil Services exam: Cabinet approves unlimited attempts for all categories, removes cap on OPSC recruitment test
articles.summary: The Odisha Cabinet has approved an amendment to the Odisha Civil Services (Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination) Rules, 1991, removing the limit on the number of attempts for the OPSC Civil Services examination across all categories. Candidates can now appear for the examination unlimited times, subject to the prescribed upper age limit and other eligibility criteria..

articles.title: IOAA-Jr 2026: From Puducherry to Maharashtra, meet the 5 Indian students who won medals at the International Astronomy Olympiad
articles.summary: Indian students have won five medals, including two gold, two silver and one bronze, at the 5th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics for Juniors (IOAA-Jr) 2026 in Thailand. Competing against participants from 25 countries, the five-member contingent delivered an impressive performance.

articles.title: Who is Anna Lezhneva? Inside her love story with Pawan Kalyan
articles.summary: Anna Lezhneva, a celebrated Russian actress, enjoyed a notable 13-year marriage to actor Pawan Kalyan after they crossed paths during the making of 'Teen Maar' in 2011. Their union, which began in 2013, has resulted in two children.

articles.title: Inside the Kapoor-Khan Diwali: Kareena-Saif share cosy family photos

articles.title: Who is Nandini, Pawan Kalyan's first wife
articles.summary: Pawan Kalyan and Anna Konidala revealed their separation on November 10, concluding a 13-year marriage, which is Pawan’s third. His earlier marriages with Nandini and Renu Desai ended under unique situations, as Nandini changed her identity to Jahnvi and moved to the United States post-divorce.

articles.title: Billy Joel confirms that he is going to perform soon
articles.summary: Billy Joel has officially announced his return to the concert scene, set for a unique event at Florida Atlantic University on December 14, 2026. This show will blend live music with an interactive question-and-answer segment.
